scenes.head: How much must you sell just to *cover* your costs?

lines.say: How much do you need to sell just to cover your costs? That's break-even.
lines.cap: Sell how much to *cover your costs*? That's *break-even*.

scenes.head: Profit at three sales levels
scenes.src: Illustrative example, not a real company.

lines.say: An illustrative business has six hundred thousand dirhams of fixed costs a year.
Every sale leaves thirty percent after variable costs.
lines.cap: Every sale leaves *30%* after variable costs.

lines.say: So break-even is two million in sales: six hundred thousand divided by thirty percent.

scenes.disc: General information only, not legal or tax advice. Illustrative example, not a real company.
